hook: Inside Miami investment firm 777 Partners, a massive five hundred million dollar fraud scheme hid in plain sight.

sections.voiceover: Inside Miami investment firm 777 Partners, a massive five hundred million dollar fraud scheme hid in plain sight.
b_roll: Exterior shot of 777 Partners office in Miami
Courtroom sketch in Manhattan federal court

sections.voiceover: Federal prosecutors in Manhattan state forty-five-year-old co-founder Josh Wander bilked investors out of cash. Where did the missing funds go before the Miami firm collapsed?
b_roll: Seal of Southern District of New York

sections.voiceover: Lenders and investors lost every single dollar except the ones prosecutors tracked down.
Manhattan federal court recorded the guilty plea for wire fraud. Wander agreed to repay the five hundred million dollars in losses.
777 Partners collapsed under five hundred million dollars in fraud.
